description: AICTIONBOT™ buying tiles by KULIC Advisory (tool 47), built on the Execution Toolkit templates T32 (operating model) and T09 (category strategy). Builds an internal one-page guide with twelve tiles (office and consumables, IT hardware, software and subscriptions, furniture, workwear and safety, maintenance and spare parts, production material, services and consultants, marketing and print, travel, events and catering, everything else). Each tile has examples, the right channel (catalogue, call-off from a framework agreement, request to procurement or IT, travel portal, own purchase up to the small-order limit), the rule and the owner. An optional tiles list replaces the defaults (tile, includes, where, supplier, rule, owner) and marks gaps. A question such as "where do I order toner?" returns the matching tile. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

question.description: Optional question, for example "Where do I order toner?".

small_limit.description: Small-order limit in euros up to which employees may order without quotes. Default 1000.

tiles.description: Optional own tiles: tile, includes (examples), where (channel), supplier, rule, owner. German column names work too.

name: build_buying_tiles
